title: claudehenri grignon face a la revolution tranquille. les echos de valdombre 1 ghyslain hotte
abstract: cet article propose une analyse de la pensee de claudehenri grignon (18941976), auteur prolifique et pamphletaire originaire de sainteadele (quebec).si son nom evoque immediatement son oeuvre litteraire, on connait moins bien son oeuvre polemique ecrite dans le contexte de la revolution tranquille.en effet, tout au long de la decennie 1960, grignon livre plusieurs conferences et publie de nombreux articles sur diverses questions sociales.durant cette periode, le traditionaliste grignon soppose aux reformes politiques, institutionnelles et sociales realisees dans la foulee de la revolution tranquille.lhistoriographie a laisse peu de place aux penseurs dits contrerevolutionnaires tranquilles.ce texte tente de combler cette lacune.abstract • this article presents an analysis of claudehenri grignons (18941976) ideological thoughts and writings.mostly recognized for his literary success, his polemic sociopolitical and sociocultural activity in the context of quebecs quiet revolution is far less know.from 1959 to the end of the 1960s, grignon gave many conferences and published a copious amount of articles pertaining to diverse social issues.unlike most, grignon harboured a set of traditional values that opposed the political, social, and institutional reforms generated by the quiet revolution.through grignons, work, we hope to fill a gap in the historiography which has paid little attention to counterrevolutionary discourse in this period.
